module: Auxiliary pneumatic suspension controller with automatic leveling (defaultOrder 80). For each "control group" (one measurement beam + one or more airbag beam groups), it compares the measured length of the beam to a target length and opens/closes the actuator's valves (by default the "airbags" controller) in proportion to the difference. A modder uses it to set the ride height (setTargetLength), raise/lower it manually (setAdjustmentRate) or temporarily suspend the regulation.
usage:
local als = controller.getController("autoLevelSuspension")
als.setAdjustmentRate("front", 1) -- raise
als.stopAdjusting("front", true) -- freezes the new height as the target
notes: jbeam keys read in init: actuatorGroups (name of a jbeam section, list of rows {controlBeamName, controlGroupName (default = controlBeamName), beamGroup, defaultTargetLength, debug}), actuationStartDistance (0.01 m), actuationEndDistance (0.06 m), actuationDelay (0 s), minValveOpenAmount (0.15). initSecondStage reads actuatorName ("airbags").

Lengths in meters. The actuation interpolates linearly between minValveOpenAmount (difference = actuationStartDistance) and 1 (difference = actuationEndDistance); below actuationStartDistance, the valve is closed.
Without defaultTargetLength, the group spends 1.5 s in calibration after reset/init then takes the current length as the target.
The groupNames parameters of the functions accept a group name or a list of names; an unknown name logs a warning (W) and is ignored.
If the actuator controller is not found, updateFixedStep is replaced by nop (log E "suspension.init").
The state (getState/setState) uses keys <controller name>_<group>_targetLength and ..._adjustmentRate.

Probable bug: reset sets commitNewHeight to 0 (number) whereas everywhere else it is a boolean. In Lua 0 is true, so at the first step after a reset (outside calibration, without manual adjustment) `if controlGroup.commitNewHeight` is true and the target is overwritten by the current length (even with defaultTargetLength).

init.desc: Builds the control groups from the jbeam section actuatorGroups and reads the actuation parameters.

initSecondStage.desc: Gets the actuator controller (jbeam actuatorName, "airbags" by default). Called after the init of all controllers.

reset.desc: Resets targets, lengths, timers and adjustment speeds to zero; restarts the calibration of groups without defaultTargetLength.

updateFixedStep.desc: Physics step: for each group, calibrates, applies a manual adjustment or regulates toward the target length via actuator.setBeamGroupsValveState.

setTemporarilyDisabled.desc: Suspends (true) or resumes (false) the automatic regulation of the groups; valves closed during suspension.

setAdjustmentRate.desc: Forces a manual height adjustment: the valve state is imposed at rate (-1 lowers, 1 raises).

stopAdjusting.desc: Stops the manual adjustment; with commitNewHeight true the current length becomes the new target.

commitNewHeight.desc: Store the reached height as the target.

setMomentaryIncrease.desc: Deprecated (log W): equivalent to setAdjustmentRate(groups, 1) then stopAdjusting(groups, true).

setMomentaryDecrease.desc: Deprecated (log W): equivalent to setAdjustmentRate(groups, -1) then stopAdjusting(groups, true).

setTargetLength.desc: Sets the target length (m) of the groups; with immediate true, the regulation starts without waiting for actuationDelay.

targetLength.desc: Target length of the measurement beam in m.

getTargetLength.desc: Returns the target length of a group (0 and log E if unknown).

getCurrentLength.desc: Returns the last measured length of the control beam (0 and log E if unknown).

getAverageFlowRate.desc: Average air flow in the actuator's beam groups for this group.

isMoving.desc: True if the absolute value of the average flow exceeds 1e-4.

isCalibrating.desc: True while the group is in initial calibration (1.5 s).

getState.desc: Saveable state: target length and adjustment rate of each group (keys prefixed by the controller name).

setState.desc: Restores targets and adjustment rates (NaN or non-numeric values ignored).
